def my_errorbar(df_drug, df_gtype):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.8, 4.8))
    ys = np.arange(len(df_drug))
    means = df_drug.loc[:, 'mean']
    SDs = df_drug.loc[:, 'sd']
    offset = 0.05
    color_genotype = 'blue'
    color_drug = 'red'
    ax.errorbar(x=df_gtype.loc[:, 'mean'], y=ys - offset, xerr=df_gtype.sd, fmt='o', linewidth=1, color=color_genotype, label='genotype effect')
    ax.errorbar(x=df_drug.loc[:, 'mean'], y=ys + offset, xerr=df_drug.sd, fmt='o', linewidth=1, color=color_drug, label='drug effect')
    ax.legend(loc='best')
    xlim = (means.abs() + SDs).max() * 1.05
    ax.set_xlim(-xlim, xlim)
    ax.axvline(0, color='k', linestyle='dashed')
    ax.set_yticks(ys)
    yticklabels = 4 * ['WT'] + 2 * ['WT, DMSO'] + ['WT'] + ['5xFAD']
    #yticklabels = (df_drug.shape[0] - 1) * ['WT'] + ['5xFAD']
    twin_yticklabels = df_drug.index[: -1].to_list() + ['TUDCA']
    ax.set_yticklabels(yticklabels, color=color_genotype)
    ax.set_title(r'Effect, posterior mean $\pm$ SD')
    twin_ax = ax.twinx()
    twin_ax.set_yticks(ys)
    twin_ax.set_ylim(ax.get_ylim())
    twin_ax.set_yticklabels(twin_yticklabels, color=color_drug)
    ax.set_xlabel(r'improved $\leftarrow$ rel. learning rate $\beta_1$  $\rightarrow$ worsened')
    ax.set_ylabel('Genotype treatment', color=color_genotype)
    twin_ax.set_ylabel('Drug treatment', color=color_drug)
    ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='dotted')
    return((fig, ax))

def ttest_plot(treatment_a='Saline TG', treatment_b='TUDCA + HCQ TG', study_a='CO28154', study_b=None, hue='Condition', return_df=False):
    study_b = study_a if study_b is None else study_b
    study2dataw = {'CO28152': dataw_CO28152, 'CO28154': dataw_CO28154}
    dataw_a, dataw_b = [study2dataw[study].copy() for study in [study_a, study_b]]
    dataw_a['Study'] = study_a
    dataw_b['Study'] = study_b
    Z = zip([treatment_a, treatment_b], [dataw_a, dataw_b])
    df = pd.concat([dataw.loc[dataw.Treatment == treatment] for treatment, dataw in Z], axis=0)
    id_vars = ['Cohort', 'Group', 'Sex', 'Genotype', 'Treatment', 'Study']
    data_vars = [x for x in df.columns if re.match('^NF-L week \d{1,2}$', x)]
    df = df[id_vars + data_vars]
    df = df.melt(id_vars=id_vars, value_name='NF-L')
    df['Week'] = df.variable.str.replace('NF-L week ', '').astype('int64')
    if treatment_a != treatment_b:
        df['Treatment'] = pd.Categorical(df.Treatment, categories=[treatment_a, treatment_b], ordered=True)
    df['Condition'] = df.apply(lambda r: r.loc['Treatment'] + ', ' + r.loc['Study'], axis=1)
    df = df.dropna()
    if return_df:
        return(df)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, sharex=True, figsize=(3.6, 4.8))
    sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Week', y='NF-L', hue=hue, ax=ax[0], boxprops={'alpha': 0.5})
    sns.stripplot(data=df, x='Week', y='NF-L', hue=hue, dodge=True, ax=ax[0], legend=False)
    sns.move_legend(ax[0], 'lower center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1))
    #fig.legend([mpatches.Circle((0, 0), color=c for c in ['C0', 'C1']], [treat
    ax[0].grid(axis='y', which='both')
    ax[0].set_xlabel('')
    weeks = [0, 4, 8, 12]
    pvalues = [nfl.my_ttest(treatment_a, treatment_b, dataw_a, dataw_b, var='NF-L week ' + str(i)).pvalue for i in weeks]
    ax[1].plot(np.arange(len(weeks)), pvalues, marker='o', linewidth=0, color='k')
    ax[1].set_yscale('log')
    ax[1].grid(axis='y', which='both')
    ax[1].axhline(0.05, color='k', linestyle='dotted', linewidth=2)
    ax[1].set_xlabel('weeks after treatment')
    ax[1].set_ylabel(r'$p$-value')
    return((fig, ax, pvalues))

def ttest_heatmap(resl, hspace_denom=None):
    height_ratios = [len(df) for df in resl]
    hspace_denom = 40 if hspace_denom is None else hspace_denom
    gridspec_kw = {'hspace': sum(height_ratios) / hspace_denom}
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(len(resl), 2, figsize=(3.6, sum(height_ratios) * 0.5), height_ratios=height_ratios, squeeze=False, gridspec_kw=gridspec_kw)
    for i, res in enumerate(resl):
        axes = ax[i, :]
        do_cbar = i == 0
        axes = ttest_heatmap_axes(axes, res, do_cbar=do_cbar)
        if i < len(resl) - 1:
            for j in range(2):
                axes[j].set_xlabel('')
                axes[j].set_xticklabels('')
            #[axes[j].set_xlabel('') for j in [0, 1]]
            #[axes[j].set_xlabel('') for j in [0, 1]]
    return((fig, ax))


def ttest_heatmap_axes(axes, res, do_cbar=True):
    #fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(3.6, res.shape[0] * 0.55), sharey=True)
    for ax, pvalue in zip(axes, [True, False]):
        stat = 'p value' if pvalue else 't statistic'
        data = res.xs(stat, level=1, axis=1)
        data = data.map(np.log10) if pvalue else data
        vmax = 0 if pvalue else 4
        vmin = -3 if pvalue else -vmax
        cmap = 'hot' if pvalue else 'BrBG_r'
        label = r'$\log_{10} p$ value' if pvalue else r'$t$ statistic'
        cbar_kws = {'orientation': 'horizontal', 'location': 'top', 'label': label}
        axim = ax.imshow(X=data, aspect='auto', vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax, cmap=cmap)
        #axim = ax.imshow(X=data, aspect='equal', vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax, cmap=cmap)
        if do_cbar:
            plt.colorbar(mappable=axim, **cbar_kws)
        ax.set_yticks(list(range(data.shape[0])) if pvalue else [])
        if pvalue:
            ax.set_yticklabels(data.index)
        ax.set_xticks(list(range(4)))
        ax.set_xticklabels([str(int(i)) for i in [0, 4, 8, 12]], rotation=0)
        ax.set_xlabel('weeks')
    return(axes)

def fitter(formula, group_list, treatments=treatments, df=nfl_invivo, return_data=False, mixed=True):
    data = df.loc[df.Group.isin(group_list)].copy()
    treatment_list = [treatments[g] for g in group_list]
    s = data.Group.apply(lambda g: treatments[g])
    data['Treatment'] = pd.Categorical(s, categories=treatment_list, ordered=True)
    data = data.dropna()
    if return_data:
        return(data)
    if mixed:
        result = smf.mixedlm(formula, data=data, groups='IRN').fit()
    else:
        result = smf.ols(formula, data=data).fit()
    return(result)

def results_plotter(results, suptitle='', drop_intercept=True):
    df = pd.concat([results.params.to_frame('mean'),
                    results.bse.to_frame('bse'),
                    results.pvalues.to_frame('pval')], axis=1)
    df['treatment'] = df.index
    df = df.drop('Intercept') if drop_intercept else df
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True, figsize=(9.6, 4.8))
    ax[0].axvline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
    ax[0].grid(linestyle='dotted')
    ax[0].errorbar(y=np.arange(df.shape[0]), x=df['mean'], xerr=df['bse'], linewidth=0, elinewidth=1, marker='d', capsize=0)
    ax[0].set_title(r'$\hat{\beta}_j \pm \mathrm{SE}_j$')
    ax[1].axvline(1, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
    sns.stripplot(x='pval', y='treatment', ax=ax[1], data=df)
    ax[1].grid(linestyle='dotted')
    ax[1].set_xscale('log')
    ax[1].set_xlabel('')
    ax[1].set_title(r'$p$-value for $H_{0j}: \; \beta_j = 0$')
    fig.suptitle(suptitle)
    return((fig, ax))

def FC_y_posterior_vertical_violin_ax(axi, idata=None, FC_y_max=FC_y_max):
    npoints = 400
    H1_increase = False
    yy = np.linspace(0, FC_y_max, npoints)
    c_left = 'red' if H1_increase else 'green'
    c_right = 'red' if not H1_increase else 'green'
    c_center = 'gray'
    axi.axhline(1, color='k', linewidth=2)
    t_1 = scipy.stats.gamma.ppf(cba.default_H1_prior_prob, cba.gamma_shape, scale=1/cba.gamma_shape)
    t_2 = scipy.stats.gamma.ppf(1 - cba.default_H1_prior_prob, cba.gamma_shape, scale=1/cba.gamma_shape)
    for t in [t_1, t_2]:
        axi.axhline(t, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
    b_left = yy <= t_1
    b_right = yy > t_2
    b_center = (~ b_left) & (~ b_right)
    if idata is None:
        xx = scipy.stats.gamma.pdf(yy, cba.gamma_shape, scale=1/cba.gamma_shape)
        title = 'prior'
        P_H1, P_H2 = [cba.default_H1_prior_prob] * 2
        condition = ''
        mean = 1
        stdev = cba.gamma_shape ** (-1/2)
    else:
        posterior = idata.posterior['FC_y']
        l = list(itertools.chain(*posterior.to_numpy()))
        k = scipy.stats.gaussian_kde(l)
        xx = k.evaluate(yy)
        title = 'posterior'
        P_H1, P_H2 = [cba.get_H1_posterior_prob(posterior, H1_increase=b) for b in [H1_increase, ~ H1_increase]]
        condition = '|\mathrm{data}'
        mean = np.mean(l)
        stdev = np.std(l)
    for b, c in zip([b_left, b_center, b_right], [c_left, c_center, c_right]):
        axi.fill_betweenx(yy[b], xx[b], - xx[b], alpha=.5, linewidth=0.5, color=c)
    axi.errorbar(x=0, y=mean, yerr=stdev, c='yellow', capsize=3, ecolor='yellow')
    axi.scatter(x=0, y=mean, c='blue', edgecolors='yellow', marker='o', linewidths=1)
    #ax.scatter(x=1, y=y_base, c=scatter_c, marker='o', linewidths=linewidths_c, edgecolors=scatter_edgecolors)
    axi.set_xticks([])
    yticks = [0, t_1, 1, t_2]
    yticklabels = ['0', '$t_1$', '1', '$t_2$']
    axi.set_yticks(yticks)
    axi.set_yticklabels(yticklabels)
    axi.set_title(title)
    axi.set_ylim(0, FC_y_max)
    #axi.set_ylabel('$\mathrm{FC}_y$: fold change')
    x = 0.5
    y_1 = t_1 / 2
    y_0 = 1
    y_2 = (FC_y_max - t_2) / 2 + t_2
    P_H0 = 1 - P_H1 - P_H2
    for y, P_H, i, c in zip([y_1, y_0, y_2], [P_H1, P_H0, P_H2], [1, 0, 2], ['green', 'gray', 'red']):
        s = '$P(H_' + str(i) + condition + ') = {:.2f}$'.format(P_H)
        bbox = {'edgecolor': c, 'facecolor': 'white', 'alpha': 1}
        axi.text(x, y, s, va='center', ha='left', color=c, backgroundcolor='white', bbox=bbox)
    return(axi)
